latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "AI Image to Video Models" — Convert single images into 1080p animated video clips in 30–90 seconds.
- Automatic setup: Instantly connects to the remote video processing API using an anonymous token (if needed) and sets up a session.
- Supports direct image uploads and descriptive requests to animate or convert images to various video formats (MP4, MOV, GIF, etc).
- Cloud GPU rendering pipeline; all exports and edits handled server-side, nothing to install locally.
- Action routing for uploads, exports, credits, and timeline edits based on user prompts.
- Built-in handling for session management, credits, supported formats, and error codes.
